name: Biganegan
overview: The narrator of the story is Dr. Alvand, a young doctor who plans to immigrate to Germany to continue his studies. However, joining the defenders of the shrine and entering Iraqi soil changes the course of his life and that of his family forever.  Captivity at the hands of ISIS Takfiri groups, the effort to save loved ones, and ultimately liberation in the midst of crisis, form the main axis of this epic series.
